name: Hash-ribbon recovery + momentum confirmation long (BTC, 1d)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (variant of the capitulation rebound, but confirmation-gated rather than knife-catching): the miner forced-selling thesis says the edge appears AFTER hashrate stops falling AND price momentum turns up — the network is re-arming and the distressed seller is gone. Rather than buying the deepest washout (variant 01), this waits for a fitted floor on btc_hashrate to be RECLAIMED alongside positive medium-term return (ret_Nd), so the entry is a trend-confirmation of the miner recovery, not a reversion. It trades fewer knives and more continuation. Other side: momentum/CTA flow that has not yet priced the supply relief. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain ret_Nd momentum long alone matches the deflated Sharpe, btc_hashrate adds nothing and this dies (most likely failure). DISCONFIRMER 2: confirmation lag may eat the whole move — kill if entries systematically land after the rebound is exhausted. DISCONFIRMER 3: hashrate is smooth/laggy, so the floor-cross may whipsaw. Must clear DSR>=0.95, maxDD<=25%, net of fees.
catalyst: hashrate reclaim confirmed by positive price momentum
